item.title: ‘Rescoring Richter’ sonifies the abstract
item.description: How much does sound shape our viewing experience of a film? “​​Rescoring Richter” explores this question by reimagining and re-sonifying films from a century ago. “Rescoring Richter” came to Vassar on Jan. 31 in the Martel Recital Hall.
